readings: For processing runs with memusagegb greater than 60.8 GB whose zoneref matches a site, calculate for each site code and entrystat the average memusagegb and the average of procgpu ÷ proccpu, ignoring missing values and excluding zero CPU values from the ratio. Then, for each entrystat, return the unrounded average of the per-site RAM averages and the unrounded average of the per-site GPU/CPU ratio averages.

For processing runs with memusagegb greater than or equal to 60.8 GB whose zoneref matches a site, calculate for each site code and entrystat the average memusagegb and the average of procgpu ÷ proccpu, ignoring missing values and excluding zero CPU values from the ratio. Then, for each entrystat, return the unrounded average of the per-site RAM averages and the unrounded average of the per-site GPU/CPU ratio averages.
queries:
WITH site_averages AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneregistry,
        s.entrystat,
        AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_memusagegb,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN p.proccpu <> 0 THEN 1.0 * p.procgpu / p.proccpu
        END) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
    FROM scanprocessing AS p
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
    WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_memusagegb) AS avg_site_memusagegb,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat

    FROM scanprocessing AS p
    JOIN sites AS s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
)
SELECT
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_memusagegb) AS avg_site_memusagegb,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM site_averages
GROUP BY entrystat
